newsitem.title: USA: Cisneros Group in venture with RSL Communications.
newsitem.headline: Cisneros Group in venture with RSL Communications.

text.p: RSL Communications Ltd and Venezuela's Cisneros Group said Tuesday they formed a joint venture to develop a network of telecommunications companies in Latin America.

In a statement, the companies said the venture, called RSL COM Latin America, will establish a network of locally managed telecommunications operations to provide long-distance voice services and other products throughout Latin America.
The venture is 51 percent owned by RSL and 49 percent owned by the Cisneros Group, they said. Other terms were not disclosed. Both companies are privately-held.
They said RSL COM Latin America will focus on newly deregulated telephone markets and target small- and mid-sized businesses.
